Definition: A control that shows data in a grid of rows and columns.
One box in a spreadsheet, where a row and a column meet.
The column letter and row number of a cell, such as C2 for the third column of the second row.
A comma separated value file: a text file with one row per line and a comma between the values in a row.
A value made of characters. In a Quorum spreadsheet, every cell holds text, even when it seems to be a number.
Data where the same thing is always written the same way, without extra spaces, typing mistakes or unexplained gaps.
To take back the last change. Redo puts it back again.
